cases.name: catch-literal
cases.source: export function* sequence(): Generator<number, number, unknown> { try { yield 20; } catch (error) { if (error === 42) { yield error; } else { throw error; } } return 0; }

cases.name: catch-typeof
cases.source: export function* sequence(): Generator<number, number, unknown> { try { yield 20; } catch (error) { if (typeof error === "number") { yield error; } } return 0; }

cases.name: catch-early-throw
cases.source: export function* sequence(): Generator<number, number, unknown> { try { yield 20; } catch (error) { if (typeof error !== "number") { throw error; } yield error; } return 0; }
